blocks.text: Hydrogen bond dipole-dipole force ki ek special type (khas qisam) hai. Intermolecular forces mein yeh sab se mazboot hai, lekin major bonds (ionic, metallic aur covalent) sab se kamzor hai. Hydrogen bond tab banta hai jab yeh do conditions (shartein) poori hon:

items: Hydrogen atom kisi bohat electronegative atom, jaise F, O ya N, se jura ho.
Us electronegative atom par electrons ka kam az kam ek lone pair ho.

blocks.text: Bohat electronegative atom aur hydrogen ke darmiyan covalent bond bohat polar hota hai: hydrogen par kaafi δ+ charge aur electronegative atom par δ− charge aa jata hai. Electronegative atom ka lone pair is δ+ hydrogen ko apni taraf khinch kar F, O ya N se ek bond banane deta hai; isi ko hydrogen bond kehte hain. Ise dotted line (…) se dikhate hain aur is ki strength (taqat) aam covalent bond ka taqreeban dasvan (1/10) hissa hai. Ek molecule on average (on average) kitne hydrogen bonds bana sakta hai, yeh do cheezon par depend karta hai:

items: electronegative atom se jure hydrogen atoms ki tadaad
F, O ya N par lone pairs ki tadaad

blocks.text: Pani ke molecule mein do hydrogen atoms aur oxygen par do lone pairs hain, is liye woh on average do hydrogen bonds banata hai. Isi liye pani ke molecules aapas mein bohat zyada hydrogen bonded hain. Pani ki khas properties, maslan us ka ooncha boiling point (100 ℃), isi wajah se hain. Liquid pani mein molecules three-dimensional (3D) arrangement (tarteeb) mein hote hain, jaisa Figure 5.4 mein hai. Yeh bond do electronegative oxygen atoms ke darmiyan bridge (pul) ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan “Fig. 42” likhti hai; sahi hawala Figure 5.4 (pani mein hydrogen bonding) hai.

blocks.alt: Beech wala pani ka molecule (O δ-, do H δ+), us ke oxygen par do green lone-pair lobes. Oopar ke do pani molecules ke H atoms pink hydrogen bonds se in lone pairs se jure hain. Beech wala molecule ke do H atoms neeche ke do pani molecules ke O atoms se pink hydrogen bonds se jure hain. Har O par δ- aur har H par δ+.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Pani mein hydrogen bonding (kitab ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Doosri taraf ammonia mein teen hydrogen atoms hone ke bawajood har molecule sirf ek hydrogen bond banata hai, kyunke N atom par sirf ek lone pair hai (Figure 5.5). Liquid ammonia mein hydrogen bonding pani se bohat kamzor hai, isi liye us ka boiling point bohat kam hai (-33℃). HF in dono se alag hai: F par teen lone pairs hain jo teen H-bonds bana sakte, lekin H sirf ek hai, is liye woh bhi sirf ek bond tak limited (mehdood) hai. Phir bhi F ki bohat zyada electronegativity ki wajah se HF ka hydrogen bond NH₃ se kaafi mazboot hai. Is liye HF ka b.p (19.9℃) ammonia (–33.5℃) se bohat zyada hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ammonia ke liye “as shown in Figure 5.4” likhti hai; ammonia ki hydrogen bonding Figure 5.5 mein hai, Figure 5.4 pani ki hai.

Solid HF mein molecules hydrogen bonds ki wajah se zig-zag (tehri-merhi) chain mein jurte hain. HCl, HBr aur HI ke muqable mein HF ka acid itna kamzor kyun hai? Isi mazboot hydrogen bonding ki wajah se: δ+ hydrogen do bohat electronegative atoms ke darmiyan phans jata hai (Figure 5.5), is liye asani se H⁺ ban kar alag nahi hota.

blocks.alt: Key: pink lines hydrogen bond, seedhi line covalent bond. Baen: ammonia ke do molecules, har N (δ-) ke saath teen H (δ+); oopar wale molecule ka ek H neeche wale N ke green lone-pair lobe se hydrogen bond se juda. Daen: teen H-F molecules zigzag mein; har H δ+ aur har F δ-, aur har F ka lone pair agle molecule ke H se hydrogen bond leta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: NH3 aur HF mein hydrogen bonding (kitab ki Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.5 mein HF chain ka pehla F chhapa hi nahi (sirf H aur ek lone pair nazar aata hai), aur F atoms par δ+ likha hai. Sahi yeh hai ke F zyada electronegative hai, is liye har F par δ− aur har H par δ+ hota hai; hamari drawing mein teenon H−F molecules poore hain. Har F ka lone pair agle HF ke H ko khinch kar hydrogen bond banata hai, isi liye chain zig-zag hai. NH₃ mein N par sirf ek lone pair hai, is liye har NH₃ on average ek hi hydrogen bond banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Pani ka boiling point ammonia aur HF dono se zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Pani ke paas do H aur do lone pairs hain, is liye har molecule on average do hydrogen bonds banata hai. Ammonia (ek lone pair) aur HF (ek H) sirf ek ek bond banate hain. Zyada hydrogen bonds torne ke liye zyada energy chahiye, is liye pani 100 ℃ par ubalta hai.

items: Hydrogen bond: H, F/O/N se jura ho aur us atom par lone pair ho; intermolecular forces mein sab se mazboot, covalent bond ka taqreeban 1/10, dotted line (…) se dikhate hain.
Bonds ki tadaad H aur lone pairs mein se kam wale par: pani 2 (b.p. 100 ℃), ammonia 1 kamzor (-33 ℃), HF 1 mazboot (19.9 ℃); HF ki zig-zag chain aur kamzor acid strength isi bonding se.
